name: tracework
description: Turn agent work into evidence-backed progress reports — daily, weekly, and monthly, with local decision replay when work is questioned later.

interface.shortDescription: Turn agent work into evidence-backed progress reports
interface.longDescription: Close agent work into evidence-backed daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports. Capture key facts when you wrap up a session, keep work and personal projects partitioned, and replay decisions only when the work is questioned or resumed.
defaultPrompt: Use Tracework to write this week's scoped weekly brief with /tracework:weekly.
Use Tracework to write today's scoped daily report with /tracework:daily.
Use Tracework to capture this key session with /tracework:capture.
Use Tracework to create a raw-first monthly review with /tracework:monthly.
Use Tracework to recover today's scoped session evidence with /tracework:capture day.
